docs.title: Black Grid
docs.text: Software built and hosted by Black Grid for construction and project delivery — from the Deep Space construction operating system and Revit automation to AI-assisted project management and professional tooling.

docs.title: What we build
docs.text:
• DS Pro

    The technical intelligence engine of the Deep Space construction operating system: model audit, BIM data, programme and cost integration, DS Site in the field, and KAI. Capabilities reference, mobile app overview and the full release changelog back to 2020.

    Explore DS Pro · Changelog

  • ShadowGrid

    A Black Grid add-in for Autodesk Revit that puts a ShadowGrid tab on the ribbon and runs automation script packs supplied by Black Grid. Ships with its own embedded Python runtime, installs per user with no admin rights, one installer for Revit 2023–2025.

    ShadowGrid

  • Client Implementation Board

    A client-safe portal into the implementation work Black Grid tracks for each customer: read-only issue lists and detail pages drawn from a GitHub Projects board, with verified email-link sign-in and sanitised data.

    Client Implementation Board

  • PM Grid

    AI-assisted project management. A high-density, monochrome grid for projects, events and tasks, with modular DataBlocks you can select as context for an AI agent that generates structured tasks and events.

    PM Grid · pmgrid.blackgrid.com.au

  • ProXP

    Your professional experience, amplified. Record project work with roles and context, connect past collaborators, collect peer kudos that validate your involvement, and publish a shareable portfolio.

    ProXP · proxp.blackgrid.com.au

  • mytendrils

    Save AI conversations. Capture a conversation from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor or any tool with one HTTP POST and receive it by email — no sign-in, callable from the command line, scripts or mobile.

    mytendrils · mytendrils.blackgrid.com.au

  • bg-mem

    A self-hosted memory layer for any LLM. Durable, searchable long-term memory that any model or tool can read and write over the Model Context Protocol — facts, decisions and context that survive the session, on infrastructure you own.

    bg-mem

  • What Revit Wants

    Luke Johnson's long-running blog on Revit, BIM, construction technology and AI-empowered project management — pragmatic, domain-first commentary on where digital construction is going.

    wrw.is

docs.title: DS Site (Codesafe)
docs.text:
Connecting people, valuable resources and information on the run.

Revitalise and mobilise any business process and get the right information to the right person on demand. Spend less time on tedious paperwork, administrative tasks, and written procedures, and more time on the business with your own channel on the DS Site communication platform and mobile app.

docs.title: A central hub for quality, safety, training, and communication
docs.text:
With the DS Site mobile application, workers can access everything they need to perform their role successfully and safely from a single location. Crucial information, instruction, and micro-learning videos can be easily accessed anytime and anywhere via a mobile device.

Activate and make available valuable content to workers, whether they are:

  • Full-time employees
  • Part-time staff
  • Sub-contractor workforce

docs.title: Combine compliance and quality assurance
docs.text:
Empower workforces with micro-learning videos and critical instruction to help prevent on-and-offsite safety incidents and improve quality outcomes.

Offline Access: The DS Site mobile app’s offline capabilities allow workers to download valuable information when in range and seamlessly access and submit content in remote areas. This ensures consistent work processes are engaged with and followed every time.

docs.title: Modernise workplace training
docs.text:
Reinvent how you deliver training by capturing key messages in short micro-learning videos and hosting them on the DS Site platform for on-demand access.

The DS Site user interface makes it easy to distribute visual content directly to workers, guaranteeing consistent practices and helping them to complete tasks or projects on time and within budget.

docs.title: Simple & effective communication
docs.text:
Link digital and visual content from any part of the organisation to a single central hub for on-demand delivery to your workforce.

  • Seamless Integration: You don’t need to abandon your existing systems. The DS Site platform and mobile app seamlessly integrate with your current systems, acting as a single hub of information.
  • Reduced Friction: This reduces adoption resistance and the cost of implementation.
  • Enhanced Connectivity: Communication with your teams is enhanced through integration with 1000+ premium applications to drive the best outcomes.

docs.title: Confident & competent workforce
docs.text: Getting the right information quickly to the right person is critical to ensure consistent outcomes in a workplace, improve productivity, and build a confident and competent workforce. Using the DS Site mobile app to connect to many different systems means your workers will always have easy access to what they need to know.

docs.title: Virtual eyes in the field
docs.text:
The DS Site mobile app can be your virtual eyes in the field, providing visibility and insight across your organisation. It facilitates:

  • Inspections and audits
  • Real-time pre and post-job reports
  • Issue identification and resolution
  • Remote task and project management

docs.title: DS Site’s Digital Passport
docs.text:
Manages compliance and training information

Imagine how much time and money both you and your workers could save if licenses, tickets, and other compliance information were readily available, and reminders for their currency maintained automatically?

The DS Site mobile app provides a free digital passport that collects, stores, and manages commonly accessed compliance information in a worker profile. That information can be used to auto-fill forms, inductions, and training records without unnecessary double handling from site-to-site and job-to-job.

  • Store Information: Refresh knowledge anywhere, anytime (on and offline).
  • Stay Current: Instantly receive all updates and notifications to minimise the impact of training and inductions changing one day to the next.
  • Free Access: A free app for users ensures you don’t miss out on critical visual and digital content, whether you are a full-time employee or sub-contractor.

docs.title: Reliable, real-world solutions
docs.text: All solutions hinge on our proven award-winning framework, called the Experiential Learning Program (ELP), which leads teams through identifying, capturing and transferring organisational expertise. Using the ELP methodology and drawing on the decades of experience of our team of consultants, we help you to capture and communicate critical workplace procedures in the most visual means possible. Our framework empowers any sized organisation to take advantage of the use of mobile visual micro-learning tools in their business.

docs.title: Operational solutions
docs.text:
• Supply chain training and instruction: Tracked and monitored engagement with standardised visual resources through the QIN user interface, providing greater visibility into a remote sub-contractor workforce.
  • Contractor management and compliance: Created a mobile digital visual training, job allocation and compliance solution to better manage a sub-contractor labour force employed across multiple sites.
  • Overcoming language and literacy barriers: Provided translation services and native language support to existing videos and verification of engagement forms to ensure correct work procedures are comprehended and acted upon.
  • Engagement visibility: Tracked and monitored engagement with visual content.

Find out more

docs.title: Workforce development and training
docs.text:
• High-volume training solution: Ensured industry practitioners engaged with supplemental training material to produce better and safer outcomes for tradespeople and customers.
  • Mobile skills-refresher delivery: Produced a series of instructional videos delivering standardised training via a mobile device to help remote workers to avoid potential hazards at work.
  • Communication coaching: Conducted a series of Effective Communication Workshops to equip frontline leaders to run compelling team briefings that increased engagement and understanding of critical information.
  • Offline mobile capability: Bridged the gap between the office and the field with a mobile solution that offers offline capabilities to remote workers, maintaining continuity and improving work processes.

docs.text:
DS Pro for Design 22 Nov 2024 #39240 Copy link

Variations v2 now supports Project Milestones!

  • create Project Milestones
  • view object counts
  • quickly pick which milestones you want to compare
  • view model quantities
  • quantities are linked with spatial information included Building, Level and Room
  • see summarised quantities by Category, Family and Type
  • pick which Parameter you want to display
  • export the summarised data

What's changed here? The previous version of Variations only supported 2 moments in time and required a dataset refresh, but this version allows you to dynamically pick which Milestones to compare. Much faster and more powerful for the end user, this gives key insight on changes in the project over time, which can affect Claims and Variations.

docs.title: DS Pro — Deep Space Construction Intelligence Platform
docs.text: Deep Space is the construction operating system Black Grid builds, implements and supports. This section is the capabilities reference, the DS Site mobile app overview, and the complete release changelog.

docs.title: Executive Summary
docs.text:
Deep Space is a comprehensive Construction Operating System (OS) designed to unify the disjointed data landscapes of mid-to-large-scale commercial builders. The platform replaces digitized fragmentation with a "Single Source of Truth" (SSOT) paradigm, ensuring data entered once propagates seamlessly across the project lifecycle—from tender to site inspection.

The ecosystem is segmented into three interoperable product lines:

  • DS Pro: The technical intelligence engine for BIM and Data Analysts.
  • DS Harmony: The external collaboration layer for supply chain and site workforce.
  • DS Horizon: The operational backbone for financials, scheduling, and project management.

docs.title: Product lines
docs.text:
• DS Pro — Technical Intelligence

    Digital engineers, BIM managers and data analysts. Model audit, parametric data, design validation and the DS Sync add-ins for Revit, IFC and Navisworks.

    DS Pro (Technical)

  • DS Harmony — Field & Ecosystem

    Supply chain and site workforce. DS Site in the field, inductions, contractor and company management.

    DS Harmony (Field)

  • DS Horizon — Operational Backbone

    Project managers and commercial teams. Financials, scheduling, documents and project controls.

    DS Horizon (Ops)

See also Site and Mobile and the changelog.

docs.title: Strategic Architecture
docs.text:
The platform is built on a Unified Data Schema, enabling advanced cross-module intelligence:

  • 5D BIM: Cost Codes in Horizon link to Model Elements in DS Pro.
  • Spatial Intelligence: Locations in the LBS are shared by Harmony (inductions) and Horizon (defects), correlating safety incidents with specific work areas.
  • Unified Execution: The Action Engine aggregates tasks from Model Audits, Safety Rectifications, and Contract Administration into a single execution stream.

docs.title: DS Harmony: Field & Ecosystem Management
docs.text:
Target Audience: Subcontractors, Site Workforce, Safety Managers.

DS Harmony bridges the gap between the head contractor and the extended supply chain. It acts as a governance layer, ensuring the workforce is compliant, informed, and integrated.

docs.title: Core Modules
docs.text:
Vendor Management & Compliance

Supply Chain Governance * Company & Worker Registries: A master database tracking insurance, licenses, and skill qualifications for all vendors. * Insurance Tracking: Automated monitoring of policy expiry dates with notifications sent at 1-month, 1-week, and 1-day intervals. * Custom Metadata: Defines fields for diversity ratings, tier classifications, or trade codes to filter vendors for procurement.

Worker Inductions & Onboarding

Digital Onboarding * Remote Workflows: Workers complete inductions remotely via the platform before arriving on site. * Pre-filled Forms: Utilizes stored vendor metadata to auto-fill employer details, reducing data entry errors. * Real-time Status: Site admins view workers as "Inducted," "Pending," or "Expired," linking status to site access control.

DS Site (Mobile Interface)

Field Efficiency * Site-First UI: Optimized for field use with dark mode, high-contrast "Go Green" action buttons, and simplified navigation. * Badge Sharing: Workers earn portable digital badges for safety/skills that are recognized across different projects. * PDF-to-Form AI: Converts static PDF safety forms (SWMS, plant checklists) into interactive digital forms instantly.

DS Pro overview

docs.title: DS Horizon: Operational Backbone
docs.text:
Target Audience: Project Managers, Commercial Teams, Site Managers.

DS Horizon functions as the central nervous system for the construction enterprise, integrating Preconstruction, Scheduling, Procurement, Delivery, and HSEQ.

docs.title: Core Modules
docs.text:
Preconstruction & Estimating

Opportunity Management * Automatic Project Creation: Converts tender opportunities to live projects, migrating all client details, bid scopes, and documentation automatically. * Tender Packages: Centralizes package management to track bid scopes against baseline budgets and ensure pricing utilizes current design revisions.

Advanced Scheduling

Dynamic Programme Management * Interoperability: Supports XML import from Primavera P6, Asta Powerproject, and MS Project, preserving complex WBS and dependencies. * Subcontractor Portal: Allows trades to propose date changes or report progress % directly, creating a collaborative review workflow. * Bulk Editing: Enables mass modification of task sequences to adapt to site variability.

Commercial & Financial Control

Integrated Cost Management * Head Contract Register: Real-time tracking of Total Contract Value, Variations, Claims, and Payment Schedules. * Budget Structure: Hierarchical structure (Budget Categories vs. Cost Codes) with bulk import capabilities from Excel. * Xero Integration: Bidirectional sync of Invoices, Payments, and Purchase Orders, mapping Cost Codes to the Chart of Accounts. * AI Invoice Processing: Automated parsing of PDF invoices to extract details and cross-reference against Purchase Orders.

Delivery & Site Control

Site Coordination * Location Breakdown Structure (LBS): Enforces standardized spatial hierarchy (Site → Building → Level → Room) for all defects and RFIs. * Action Engine: A pervasive task management layer connecting disparate records (RFIs, Site Instructions, Defects) into a semantic knowledge graph. * Daily Diaries: Streamlined interface for high-frequency daily reporting.

HSEQ (Safety & Quality)

Integrated Workflows * Gated Progress: Links digital SWMS and Permits to the daily diary, preventing work logging without safety documentation. * Scan-to-Open: QR codes on physical assets instantly open relevant inspection forms. * Evidence Automation: Automatically extracts photos and PDFs from submitted forms and saves them to the Common Data Environment (CDE).

Documentation (CDE)

Document Control * Document Register: "Promotes" files to official records with enforced metadata and transmittal guardrails. * Correspondence Logging: Parses project emails to index content and auto-extract attachments into the CDE.

DS Pro overview

docs.title: DS Pro: Technical Intelligence & Digital Engineering
docs.text:
Target Audience: Digital Engineers, BIM Managers, Data Analysts.

DS Pro transforms raw geometric and parametric data from models into actionable project intelligence. It manages the data of the building itself, ensuring model integrity and design validation.

docs.title: Core Modules
docs.text:
BIM Management (DS BIM)

Model Audit App Automated model governance that runs checks against Revit and IFC models to ensure compliance with the BIM Execution Plan (BEP).

  • Health Checks: Validates file naming, identifies unconnected elements, monitors file sizes (e.g., <1GB), and flags imported CAD/image usage.
  • Scoring: Aggregates checks into a "Model Health Score" with dashboards for discipline-specific drill-downs (Architecture, Structure, MEP).
  • Action Integration: Allows users to tag engineers directly on specific model errors, linking the audit to the task management system.

Coordination & Plugins * Super Schedule: Links model elements to schedule tasks for 4D simulation and planning. * Revizto Integration: Pulls clash and markup data into Deep Space analytics to track resolution trends. * Unified Plugins: Supports Revit, Navisworks, and IFC with SSO and Enterprise permissions.

Design Management (DS Design)

Verify App (LOI Checking) Validates the Level of Information (LOI) within model elements against defined schemas (e.g., Asset Information Requirements) for digital handovers.

  • Parameter Validation: Checks existence and format of required parameters (e.g., "FireRating", "WarrantyDate").
  • Completeness Tracking: Tracks completion % by asset class to gate model submissions based on data maturity.

Drawing Management * Sheets and Files: Manages sheet indexes and file metadata to synchronize the drawing register with model views.

Analytics & AI (KAI)

Enterprise Intelligence * Power BI Integration: "Open data" architecture allows direct connection of Power BI to the Deep Space data store, enabling cross-domain dashboards (e.g., correlating Design Clashes with Variation Costs). * Portfolio Dashboards: Aggregates metrics like total variation value and safety incident rates into executive command centers.

KAI (Knowledge AI) * An intelligent agent capable of answering natural language questions (e.g., "Show me all overdue defects on Level 3") and generating ad-hoc reports.

docs.title: bg-mem
docs.text:
A self-hosted memory layer for any LLM.

bg-mem gives language-model tools a durable, searchable long-term memory that you own and run yourself. Facts, decisions and context captured in one session are available to the next, to a different model, or to a different tool, without depending on any vendor's memory feature.

docs.title: What it does
docs.text:
• Remember and recall: save atomic facts and search them semantically from any LLM client that speaks the Model Context Protocol.
  • Verified facts: entries can be marked as authoritative so recall can prefer what has been checked.
  • Works off-site: a portable mirror answers searches when the primary store is unreachable, and anything saved offline is queued and synced back later.
  • Capture raw context: ingest unstructured conversation text as well as curated facts.
  • Self-hosted: your data stays on your own infrastructure.

Availability

bg-mem is in use internally at Black Grid. Details will be published here as it matures.

docs.title: Client Implementation Board
docs.text:
A client-safe window into the implementation work Black Grid tracks for each customer.

Implementation issues are managed on a GitHub Projects board. The Client Implementation Board gives customers a read-only view of that work — an issue list and issue detail pages — without exposing the underlying repository.

docs.title: What it does
docs.text:
• Verified access: email-link sign-in with a server-side session, no passwords to manage.
  • Sanitised data: raw GitHub URLs, usernames and non-whitelisted labels are stripped before anything reaches the client.
  • Live board: list and detail views are read straight from the project board with short-lived caching.
  • Read-only by design: comment posting is intentionally disabled in the current release.

Availability

Provisioned per customer as part of a Black Grid implementation engagement.

docs.title: mytendrils
docs.text:
AI Context Capture — save AI conversations.

Open mytendrils

mytendrils preserves conversations from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor and similar tools so that solutions, code, research and decisions are not lost when a chat is closed.

docs.title: How it works
docs.text:
• One HTTP POST to the capture endpoint, with the conversation text and optional metadata — no account or sign-in required.
  • Delivered by email, formatted and ready to file.
  • Call it from anywhere: command-line tools, curl, Python scripts or mobile apps.

docs.title: PM Grid
docs.text:
AI-assisted project management in a high-density, monochrome grid.

Open PM Grid

PM Grid is built for people who run many projects at once and want to move between projects, events and tasks without losing context.

docs.title: Core features
docs.text:
• Multi-column grid interface: a four-column, fixed-width layout for navigating projects, events and tasks side by side.
  • Modular DataBlocks: flexible Markdown or JSON content containers that can be linked and shared across projects and events.
  • Global context selection: select any element as context for the AI agent.
  • AI action tool: analyses the selected DataBlocks and generates structured tasks, events and linked blocks.
  • Unified workspace management: contacts, tags and custom event types managed globally with real-time sync.
  • Sharing and permissions: invite-only project access with viewer and editor roles.
  • Google sign-in for onboarding.

docs.title: ProXP
docs.text:
Your professional experience, amplified.

Open ProXP

ProXP is a portfolio platform for professionals who want their project work to carry weight. Instead of a self-written résumé, involvement is validated by the people you worked with.

docs.title: How it works
docs.text:
1. Record project entries with your role and the context of the work.
  2. Connect past collaborators who were on the same projects.
  3. Collect kudos — peer endorsements that verify your contribution.
  4. Publish a shareable public portfolio backed by that verified history.

docs.title: ShadowGrid
docs.text:
A Black Grid add-in for Autodesk Revit that runs Black Grid automation script packs from a dedicated ribbon tab.

ShadowGrid adds a ShadowGrid tab to the Revit ribbon. From it you run automation scripts supplied by Black Grid as script packs — repeatable model clean-ups, tagging, audits and other jobs that would otherwise be done by hand. It ships with its own embedded Python runtime, so nothing else needs to be installed on the machine.

Revit 2023, 2024, 2025 — one installer covers every supported year on the machine Windows Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit) Rights needed None — installs per user, no administrator or UAC prompt Signing Signed with Black Grid's own code-signing certificate; a one-time trust package removes Revit's "publisher could not be verified" prompt

docs.title: How it is delivered
docs.text:
Clients receive a trust package, the add-in installer and a checksums file so they can verify what they received before installing. Script packs are installed separately and can be updated without reinstalling the add-in.

Availability

ShadowGrid is delivered directly to Black Grid clients. Install guides and script-pack documentation are provided with each release.
